text: Good evening. Your heroes have been very brave. I have taken the liberty of making that unnecessary.

text: Their powers are gone. Do listen carefully. I would hate to repeat the demonstration.

text: My associates will attend to each district. Stay inside. If you hear someone calling for a hero, let them finish.

text: Sleep well. I know how much safer you feel when someone else is watching.

text: Ah, Volt. Such a promising file. And one complaint I would like to discuss in person.

text: Mine. You have mistaken my patience for permission to enter.

text: You think the lightning makes you brave. I shall remove it, and we can meet the person underneath.

text: Of course you are. They all ask to keep something.

text: A small question, Volt. Before we begin. Indulge me.

text: Does Halo still stand on that balcony every night? Watching the city. Never looking down.

text: Ask her who stood beside her. Watch her face when you do.

text: You are breathing rather well, considering how we left things. Someone has been taking care of you.

text: I shall remember that. Someone ought to.

text: Persistence is not a power, Volt. It is simply fear that has not recognised itself yet.

text: For the moment. I prefer to let a habit establish itself before I correct it.

text: I flagged your little victory. I have spent the interval learning exactly where you break.

text: With pleasure. This time, I shall be thorough.

text: She has not told you. How considerate. She always did know what people could bear.

text: Halo and I were partners. Then the tower fell. There was time to make one choice. She made it while I was still calling her name.

text: The city was saved. I was left beneath it. She found the distinction quite manageable.

text: Redacted. There are things even she does not get to keep.

text: Because power lets a person decide who is worth saving. I have been on the other side of that decision.

text: Halo. I wondered how long you could bear to listen.

text: Of course. There is always someone else to save while I am speaking.

text: Some rooms must be kept exactly as they were. She understands why.
